title: Base changes of hypercoverings along the gamma-covering condition
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Show K x_L M is a hypercovering of X when K is a hypercovering, M_0 -> L_0 is a covering, and the gamma-arrows M_{n+1} -> L_{n+1} x_{(cosk_n sk_n L)_{n+1}} (cosk_n sk_n M)_{n+1} are coverings: at level 0, (K x_L M)_0 -> K_0 is a base change of the covering M_0 -> L_0 and K_0 -> {X->X} is a covering, so the composite is a covering by lemma-covering-permanence; for the coskeleton condition use that cosk_n sk_n commutes with fibre products (simplicial-lemma-cosk-fibre-product) to rewrite the target as A x_B C, decompose K_{n+1} x_{L_{n+1}} M_{n+1} = (K_{n+1} x_B C) x_{(L_{n+1} x_B C), gamma} M_{n+1} via the commutative cube, note K_{n+1} -> A pulls back to a covering K_{n+1} x_B C -> A x_B C, and conclude since gamma is a covering and coverings compose.
